items.title: Hit Indicator Hard to See
items.what: The hit indicator for successful punches is a small, subtle burst of light that can be hard to see, especially in bright or busy moments.
items.why: The current hit indicator is not clear or noticeable enough, making it difficult for players to understand when they have successfully landed a hit.
items.how: Increase the size and brightness of the hit indicator, or make it more visually distinct from the background.

items.title: Technique Tooltips Are Not Clear
items.what: The tooltips for techniques are not clear or descriptive, making it hard for players to understand what each technique does.
items.why: The current tooltips do not provide enough information about each technique, leading to confusion and frustration for players.
items.how: Rewrite the tooltips to be more descriptive and provide clear information about each technique.

items.title: Inconsistent Button Size
items.what: The buttons for techniques and stances are not consistent in size, making it hard to navigate and use them.
items.why: The inconsistent button size can lead to accidental taps and frustration for players.
items.how: Make all buttons consistent in size and layout.

items.title: Navigation Between Rounds Is Confusing
items.what: The navigation between rounds is not clear or intuitive, making it hard for players to understand what to do next.
items.why: The current navigation can lead to confusion and frustration for players, especially new ones.
items.how: Add clear and intuitive navigation between rounds, such as a clear "Next" or "Previous" button.

items.title: Lack of Feedback for Successful Actions
items.what: There is not enough feedback for successful actions, such as landing a hit or winning a round.
items.why: The lack of feedback can make it hard for players to understand what they are doing right or wrong.
items.how: Add clear and visual feedback for successful actions, such as a sound effect or animation.
